verdicts.evidence: lines 602-666: Refresh, filter buttons, clear, reload, row actions (paid, reminder, undo, retry, dismiss, delete), pager and both dialog buttons all have listeners that call the api or change state and re-render

lines 482-485: rows come from api.listInvoices; lines 424-429 counts and 432-442 summary are computed from that data and left blank while st.invoices is null; no hardcoded sample values or placeholder text
lines 564-565: the delete confirmation shows the invoice number in its title and the customer and amount in its description, so the earlier row context is visible at the decision
One search input and a status filter only; no multi-step task or long free text. Search, status and page are still kept in the URL (lines 255-257, 313-321)
line 200 autofocus and line 569 focus Keep draft, so Enter keeps the draft; line 155 the preselected filter is All; no risky preselection
lines 344-347, 620: Mark paid and Send reminder are single-click row buttons in the table; search and status filter are on the same screen; only permanent delete opens a dialog

lines 142-190: heading, search, status filter, result count, table, pager and delete dialog all map to the brief's tasks. Refresh (line 144) is not named in the brief but supports an all-day shared list; no stat cards, feeds or tips

lines 43-54: there is a single outlined .btn style and no filled primary style anywhere; dialog (lines 200-201) has plain Keep draft and outlined danger Delete draft, so no region has more than one primary

line 349: row Delete is an outlined danger button, shown only on draft rows with no other row action; lines 200-201, 569: in the dialog Delete draft is outlined, not default, and focus is on Keep draft

lines 457-458: Refresh is aria-disabled only during its own load and reads Refreshing; lines 553-558: dialog buttons are disabled only during the delete request with Deleting shown; lines 453-454 pager buttons and line 351 unusable row actions are absent
No title attributes, tooltips or hover cards anywhere in the markup or script
Visible strings (lines 143-201, 337-395, 564-565, 588) are headings, labels, statuses and task messages; nothing mentions the build, the framework, the brief or mocked data

line 565: the only caveat, 'Deleting it is permanent and cannot be undone', sits in the delete dialog beside the choice; line 387 'may be out of date' sits with its Try again button; no other notes or callouts
No text narrates how to use the controls. Prose is limited to the field label (line 149), state messages (lines 381-395) and the one-line empty explanation at line 390

No subtitles or helper text under the heading or search label (lines 143, 149). Dialog description (line 565) adds customer and amount to the title rather than restating it; 'permanent and cannot be undone' is a small doubling
Heading is 'Invoices' (line 143); no greeting, slogan, superlative, exclamation mark or congratulation in any string, including announcements (lines 506-537)

Action labels are specific verbs: Refresh, Mark paid, Send reminder, Delete, Undo, Try again, Dismiss, Clear search and filter, Keep draft, Delete draft (lines 144, 166, 200-201, 337-349). Filter toggles and Previous/Next page are nouns but clear alone

line 238 and 358: statuses are mapped to Draft, Sent, Paid, Overdue; line 365 shows the invoice number (NW-2041), never the internal id; dates and money are formatted for en-GB (lines 276-279); column headings are plain words

lines 381, 387, 342, 588: each message names what did not happen ('Invoices could not be loaded', 'Not marked as paid', 'was not deleted and is still in the list') plus a Try again button; the raw ECONNRESET text is never shown
lines 239, 342, 381, 387, 588: wording is 'could not be loaded', 'Not marked as paid', 'Reminder not sent', 'The server did not respond'; no 'failed', 'invalid', 'oops', exclamation marks or capitals

lines 388-390: with zero invoices the panel shows only 'There are no invoices yet. New invoices appear here once they are created.' with no button or link; the filtered-empty case (line 395) does offer Clear search and filter

lines 377-396: load failure shows a red panel with Try again (381), nothing existing shows 'There are no invoices yet' (390), and no match shows 'No overdue invoices match "x"' with Clear search and filter (394-395); three distinct states

lines 489-493 and 381/387: failed load shows a message and Try again, and a failed refresh keeps the existing rows; lines 535-537, 340-343: failed mark paid or reminder shows a row error with Try again; lines 586-591: failed delete keeps the dialog open with retry

line 383 'Loading invoices' shows at once on first load; line 457 Refresh reads Refreshing; lines 337-339 rows show Saving or Sending reminder; line 555 Deleting. Calls take at most 1.5 seconds, so no progress or cancel is needed
lines 377-383: while st.invoices is null the panel shows the loading text, not the empty text; line 428 leaves filter counts blank and line 433 leaves the summary empty until data arrives

line 91: customer wraps with overflow-wrap anywhere; lines 89-90 amounts and dates do not wrap and use tabular figures; line 279 a missing date shows 'Not set'; line 235 pages of 25; lines 114-133 rows stack on narrow screens; dialog width is capped (line 107)
No edits wait for an explicit save. Mark paid and reminder actions still inside their undo window are sent on pagehide (lines 543-549)
line 150: the only field is a free-text search with no format constraint
No form with required and optional fields; the only input is the search box (line 150)
No input validation; the search box filters as typed and never reports an error (line 635)
No form that can reject input
No form that can be rejected; the search text is untouched by any server failure
No form that can reject input
No form or submit button on the screen; actions are row buttons and a confirmation dialog
No form. Row and dialog actions do guard repeats: line 503 ignores a second start, line 524 ignores commit while sending, line 580 ignores Delete draft while busy

line 504-509: Mark paid and Send reminder re-render at once with a note and Undo; line 478-480 load sets the loading text or Refreshing label before awaiting; line 583 Delete draft switches to Deleting before the call; filters render synchronously (627-632)

lines 295-298, 358: the badge changes to Paid in place; line 362 shows 'Reminder sent' with a time under the status; line 596 removes the deleted row; lines 342 and 588 state each failure in the row or dialog
No visible success toast, banner or dialog; success text goes only to the screen-reader announcer (lines 192, 534, 598) and results show in the row

lines 236, 504, 337: the 'Marked paid' / 'Sending reminder' note with its Undo button is removed by a 6 second timer and cannot be kept open. Errors themselves do persist in place (lines 340-343, 381, 387, 588)
lines 501-520: Mark paid and Send reminder run with no confirmation dialog, show an Undo button in the row, and undoOp cancels the held request before it reaches the server

lines 564-569, 200-201: delete asks 'Delete draft NW-xxxx?', names customer and amount, says it is permanent and cannot be undone, buttons are Keep draft and Delete draft, focus on Keep draft. Reminder send is held with Undo instead (504)
lines 195-203, 624: the only confirmation dialog guards permanent deletion of a draft; mark paid, reminder, refresh and filter changes have none

lines 295-298: the row shows Paid before the server call, and when commit fails (lines 535-537) phase becomes failed so the badge and counts return to the real status, with 'Not marked as paid. The server did not respond.' and Try again (line 342)
lines 195-203, 560-570: the single modal holds one decision (delete or keep a draft) and opens only when the user presses Delete on a row

line 568 native dialog showModal traps focus; line 569 focuses Keep draft; lines 607-611 Escape closes; lines 605, 610 return focus to the row's Delete button via render(focusKey) (461-468); after a delete, focus goes to a neighbour row (593-599)
lines 142-184: the page is a heading, then search and status filter, then the invoice table; nothing decorative sits above or outweighs the table
line 143: the page opens with the h1 'Invoices' followed directly by search, filter and table; no hero, greeting or intro panel

lines 424-429: the only summary numbers are per-status counts inside the filter buttons (for example the overdue count, which opens the overdue list) and the result count at lines 432-442; no stat cards or charts

lines 432-443: the summary reads for example '12 overdue invoices matching "acme"' above the table, the pressed filter is marked (line 427, 67), and Clear search and filter appears whenever a search or filter is active (443, 395)

All controls are native buttons, a search input and a native dialog (lines 144-201, 330-333); render keeps focus on the same row or control after each re-render (lines 406-415, 461-468) and page turns keep focus on the pager (658-663)

line 358: every status badge carries its name as text; line 361 adds 'by N days' to overdue; errors are text messages (342, 381); the selected filter is also bold with a heavier border and aria-pressed (lines 67, 427)

lines 165, 169, 192, 198: summary, state panel, announcer (role status) and dialog error (role alert) exist in the page before being filled; row outcomes are sent to the announcer (506, 518, 534, 537). Load errors use role status, not alert
No accordions, disclosure buttons, menus, comboboxes or tabs; status filters are toggle buttons with aria-pressed (lines 155-159, 427)

lines 114-134: under 900px rows become stacked grid cards with Issued and Due labels, buttons and the input grow to 44px, the search field goes full width and filters wrap (line 65); dialog width is min(440px, 100vw - 32px) (line 107)
